Hoarding Merregon is a Merregon and trader that dwells in Yurgir's chamber in the Gauntlet of Shar. It serves as the Orthon's quartermaster.

Involvement

The Hoarding Merregon can initially be found taking part in Yurgir's ambush. If  Yurgir has been pacified, it lounges beside a campfire at X: -664 Y: -760.

Using  Detect Thoughts on it, reveals that it has slightly more self-will than other Merregons and that its driving purpose is to keep feeding the  Displacer Beast and protect and grow Yurgir's stock. The party can then tell the Merregon that they are tending the Displacer Beast now, which makes the Merregon give them five  Merregon Potions which can be thrown to  befuddle the enemy.

Store

The Hoarding Merregon sells items from the following item tables. This corresponds to SHA_MerregonTrader treasure table.

  • Coating Table
  • Poor Trader Table
  • Potion Table
  • Scroll Table
  • Spoiled Supply Table

Unlike most traders, the Merregon has a "gold stash", similar to enemies, rather than a "trader gold supply".
